acceptanceCriteria.text: `.github/workflows/ci.yml` uses `pnpm/setup@v2` (SHA-pinned) instead of `pnpm/action-setup` in every job listed under Task
No job runs both `pnpm/setup`'s own install and the existing explicit `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` step
A real CI run on the implementing PR shows the pnpm setup step dropping from minutes to single-digit seconds, compared against the baseline measurements above
No job `needs`, proof step, or assertion is removed or weakened

issue.title: chore: replace pnpm/action-setup with standalone pnpm/setup in CI
